title: Trigger rebuild by adding a period on the Contact page

requirements.text: Update the Contact page by adding a single period character to existing visible text (one-character-only change) without changing layout, styling, routing, or functionality.

quotes: Start the build. Start the build.

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx` contains exactly one additional `.` character compared to the current version (e.g., add a trailing period to an existing sentence).
No other functional changes are introduced (no new components, routes, links, or logic changes).
The app builds successfully after the change.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI component sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit immutable hook/entry files: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Keep backend unchanged (single-actor Motoko canister; no schema/state changes).
nonGoals: Fixing deployment/canister generation logic directly; this change is only meant to trigger a rebuild/publish.
Any redesign or content rewrite of the Contact page beyond a single added period.
Adding new pages, routes, or features.
